prompt: I'd like a command in the palette, Rename layers, for naming a batch of layers in one go. With two or more layers selected, I run it and type a base name such as Card, and the layers become Card 1, Card 2, Card 3 and so on, numbered in the order I selected them. If what I type contains a #, the number goes there instead, so Item # gives Item 1, Item 2. It should only be offered when at least two layers are selected, typing nothing should change nothing, and the renaming should be undoable.
reference: Runs the renames inside one batch, so the whole rename is one history entry.

naive.summary: One rename command per layer with no batch or shared gesture, so undoing the rename takes one Undo per layer.
